user.title: Set up Octopus Cosy to Emoncms
user.description: Configure the connection to your Emoncms instance and select which heat pump sensors to send.

data_description.node_name: Choose a unique name for your Emoncms node. Examples: octopus_hp, ha_heatpump, cosy_api. Avoid: heatpump, EmonPi2 (reserved for hardware).
data_description.entities: Select entities to send. Names will be cleaned (lowercase, underscores). Climate/water_heater entities auto-expand (e.g., 'Heating Zone 1' → heating_zone_1_cur_t, heating_zone_1_target_t). Check logs to see exact field names.

init.title: Configure Octopus Cosy to Emoncms
init.description:
Update which sensors to send and the update interval.

**Entity naming:**
Climate/water_heater entities auto-expand into multiple Emoncms fields (cur_t, target_t, hvac_act, etc.). Check logs to see exact field names.

data_description.entities: Climate entities will be split into multiple fields automatically
